task.title: Exporting a tag dictionary
task.shortdesc: You would export a custom tag dictionary to edit it outside of Niagara. You could export any tag dictionary as an example or as a template.

taskbody.prereq: You have a license to use tags and have installed the TagDictionaryService under the Services folder. You have an online or offline connection to an open Station.

step.cmd: To open the Tag Dictionary Manager view, double-click the TagDictionaryService in the Nav tree or use the right-click menu to open this view.
step.stepresult: The Tag Dictionary Manager view opens.

step.cmd: Select a tag dictionary and click Export.
Select a location to save the file, enter the desired file name (as shown), and click Save.
step.stepresult: A Results message confirms the export.

result.p: The exported structured tag dictionary is empty at this point. You can edit the file, as well as use it as a template to develop additional tag dictionaries.
result.note: You can also export the and Haystack dictionaries to use as examples.
